CREATE DATABASE ldw;
ALTER DATABASE ldw COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8;

USE ldw;

CREATE SCHEMA silver

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE silver
WITH ( location = 'https://adlsfhirnonprod.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/30tb/'),
CREDENTIAL = sqlondemand );

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE bronzeHistory
WITH ( location = 'https://adlsfhirnonprod.dfs.core.windows.net/bronze/historic_data/30tb/')

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE bronzeIncremental
WITH ( location = 'https://adlsfhirnonprod.dfs.core.windows.net/bronze/incremental_data/30tb/')

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE bronzeReference
WITH ( location = 'https://adlsfhirnonprod.dfs.core.windows.net/bronze/incremental_data/')

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS silver.claimDiagnosisView;

CREATE VIEW silver.claimDiagnosisView 
AS SELECT *
FROM  
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'Claim_diagnosis',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'silver',
        FORMAT='DELTA'
    ) 
WITH ( 
    claim_id varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    diagnosis_reference varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    diagnosis_sequence int,
    year int,
    month varchar(2) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    day varchar(2) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8
    )
    claimDiagnosis

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS bronze.observationHistoryView;

CREATE VIEW bronze.observationHistoryView
AS SELECT *, obs.filepath(1) as year
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'Observation/year=*/*.json',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'bronzeHistory',
        FORMAT='csv',
        fieldterminator ='0x0b',
        fieldquote = '0x0b'
    )
    WITH (
        doc varchar(max) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8
        ) as obs;

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS bronze.claimHistoryView;

CREATE VIEW bronze.claimHistoryView
AS SELECT *, claims.filepath(1) as year
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'Claim/year=*/*.json',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'bronzeHistory',
        FORMAT='csv',
        fieldterminator ='0x0b',
        fieldquote = '0x0b'
    )
    WITH (
        doc varchar(max) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8
        ) as claims;

FROM
    OPENROWSET(

        DATA_SOURCE = 'bronzeIncremental',
        FORMAT='csv',
        fieldterminator ='0x0b',
        fieldquote = '0x0b'
    )
    WITH (
        doc varchar(max) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8
